meta.dataset: CAMS-BD (doi:10.17632/hwmzyh5w4w.1), CC BY 4.0; weather: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive
meta.interval: LightGBM q10/q90 widened by split-conformal offset fitted on validation (CQR), nominal 80%
meta.tgt_weather_caveat: Uses ERA5 reanalysis at the target hour as a stand-in for the weather forecast the app fetches live; real forecasts are less accurate, so treat as optimistic.
meta.gru_device: Kaggle Tesla T4 (cuda); replicated on Apple M4 (mps)
